description: The state of one host name's DNS record

state.description: `off`: no record asked for; `unavailable`: the name cannot get one (see `reason`); `covered`: a wildcard or a Dynamic DNS record already serves it, nothing is created; `pending`: waiting for the provider work; `ok`: the record is kept current; `exists`: the name already holds another record and nothing was written; `failed`: the last provider call failed and is tried again; `paused`: the host is disabled; `orphan`: the delete at the provider failed or found another value, the row stays

origin.description: `created`: NPMpro made the record (deleted with the name); `adopted`: it existed and was taken over (never deleted at the provider); null: no record row

record_id.description: The id of the dynamic DNS record row, null without one

ipv6.description: Whether an AAAA record is kept too (the row's IPv6 box); null without a row

message.description: A short text for the state: the reason it is unavailable, what exists, or the error

reason.description: The translation key of the message, as `error.host-dns-no-right`, null when there is no reason

covered_by.description: For `covered`: what covers the name, as `*.example.com`; null when it is not shown to the user

found.description: For `exists`: the records found at the name

type.description: The record type: A, AAAA or CNAME

values.description: The values of the record set

adopt_allowed.description: For `exists`: whether Adopt and update is allowed (not for a set with more than one value or a CNAME)

reach.description: For a tick refused because the reach was not confirmed: the last probe result
